text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"NJ","level":"state","category":"application_screening_fees","status":"in_force","title":"New Jersey cap on residential rental application fees ($50, CPI-adjusted)","requirement":"A landlord or agent may not require an application or similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes that exceeds $50. Beginning January 1 of the year following enactment and each year after, the Director of the Division of Consumer Affairs adjusts the cap in proportion to the percent change in the CPI-U (New York-Northern New Jersey-Long Island) over the 12 months ending October 31 of the previous year. An adjustment is made only if the CPI change is greater than zero. The Director publishes the current cap annually on the Division's website.
